item.title: FEMA grants $800,000 to local fire department - WOAY-TV
item.description: Fayette County, WV (WOAY) - The Federal Emergency Management Agency has awarded an $800,000 grant to the Oak Hill Fire Department. https://youtu.be/uCP1nIS73BU The grant will be used to recruit and retain its volunteer firefighters. The money will fund a recruitment campaign, incentive and support programs, a dedicated volunteer coordinator, training and leadership development, and more.
